issues: Document has no ТР ТС / раздел section headings anywhere, so tr_section is null on every row. Row 5 (Медь) range printed as "(0,001-0049)" verbatim -- likely a typo in the source for "0,001-0,049" but transcribed as printed, not corrected. Row 11 (Жесткость общая) prints unit as °C in the source, which is physically odd for a hardness indicator but transcribed as printed. Row 14 (фосфатный фосфор) has no unit printed in the source cell (range shown only as "(0.010-100)"), so unit is null. Rows 26's two ranges print a stray extra ")" before the unit ("(0,05-6,0) ) мг/м3", "(0,01-1,5) ) мг/м3") -- transcribed as printed in raw_row_text; range_to values extracted are still 6,0 and 1,5. Printed row numbering in the source itself jumps 23 -> 26 (rows 24-25 are not present as separate numbered rows; the two extra indicators under row 23 and the two under row 26 are emitted as separate JSON rows per indicator, consistent with the numbering gap in the original document). Table cells for object/indicator/norm_doc that are visually merged across several sub-rows (e.g. "Воздух атмосферный" for rows 16-30, "Параметры газопылевых потоков" for rows 32-33, "Промышленные выбросы" for rows 34-35) were forward-filled from the nearest heading above, per merged-cell convention. Row 37 (Отбор проб / sampling method) has no numeric range in the source; range_from/to/unit are null. All pages are portrait-content rendered from a landscape-oriented PDF page (no rotation was needed, p.rotation was 0 for all 5 pages).
